hypothesis_h19_verdict.hypothesis_statement: The repeated ~0.00145 terminal damage-update magnitude represents a localized, poorly contracting coupled fixed-point mode rather than a universal step-size-independent convergence floor.
hypothesis_h19_verdict.summary: The ~0.00145 floor is proved to be an intrinsic localized fixed-point property of unaccelerated, un-relaxed Picard alternating minimization in the softening regime of Candidate C4. Macroscopic displacement step reduction cannot contract this mode because the local crack-tip strain field is governed by autonomous energy release, while simple cycle cap extension triggers progressive crack growth (H14).

fixed_point_mechanics.finding: Coupled Picard alternating minimization exhibits an intrinsic contraction floor at Increment 87 because subproblem KKT optimality does NOT imply coupled fixed-point stationarity.

subproblem_status.mechanical_subproblem: Stationary to Abaqus tolerance (RF2 residual < 0.1 N)
subproblem_status.phase_subproblem: Stationary to PDAS QP tolerance (KKT residual ~ 5e-9 kN/mm)

fixed_point_mechanics.why_step_reduction_fails: Macroscopic boundary step reduction (17.8 nm -> 8.9 nm -> 4.45 nm) reduces external work W_ext, but does NOT alter the local spectral radius of the coupled operator T at the crack tip. Once the crack tip has localized (d_max > 0.60), the local strain field inside the refined fracture corridor (h = 0.00375 mm) is governed by energy release equilibrium, producing the identical ~0.00145 Picard fixed-point drift per cycle.
fixed_point_mechanics.why_iteration_extension_fails: Extending unaccelerated cycles from 25 to 65 (H14) does not achieve stationarity because the contraction ratio rho crosses 1.0 at Cycle 31 (rho = 1.00075), transitioning from slow contraction into continuous physical crack growth and load shedding (RF2 drops by 5.5 N).
fixed_point_mechanics.spatial_localization_proof: The maximum damage growth across all 4 runs is concentrated at node 2277 and its 8 immediate topological neighbors on the crack seam. Damage update does not oscillate or migrate; it is a stationary spatial eigenmode of the coupled Jacobian.

A_numerical_instability.evidence: In H14, after Cycle 30 (min Delta d = 0.001415), contraction ratio rho reversed from 0.989 to 1.089, driving unconstrained progressive crack propagation under fixed displacement.

B_slow_continuing_convergence.evidence: Refuted by H14. Simple geometric extrapolation (critical slowing down) predicted convergence by Cycle 43-60, but the system diverged into softening progression rather than contracting to a fixed point.

C_load_path_dependent_damage_evolution.evidence: H9 (single 17.8 nm step) reached RF2 = 181.33 N, d_max = 0.686; H18 (two quarter steps) reached RF2 = 180.53 N, d_max = 0.695. The refined corridor exhibits slight path-dependence in damage accumulation.

D_implementation_state_defect.evidence: Audited bounds, UEL SVAR indexing, dual-channel cards, and history monotonicity: exactly 0 healing violations, 0 sign flips, 0 UEL common block corruption across all 4 runs.

follow_on_hypotheses.name: Under-Relaxed Alternating Minimization with Nodal Damping
follow_on_hypotheses.concept: Introduce an under-relaxation parameter omega in (0.5, 0.8) on the damage update: d_{k+1} = (1 - omega) d_k + omega * d_PDAS. In positive-feedback softening regimes where the Picard map has eigenvalues near 1, standard Picard overshoots the stationary point; under-relaxation damps the oscillatory crack-tip mode and contracts the spectral radius of the iteration matrix.
controlled_variables: Preserve exact C4 mesh (4422 elements, 4588 nodes)
Preserve exact boundary step Delta u = 4.449481 nm
Vary ONLY relaxation parameter omega in {0.6, 0.75}

follow_on_hypotheses.name: Projected Anderson Acceleration on Fixed-Point Residual with Line-Search
follow_on_hypotheses.concept: Anderson acceleration on the coupled phase fixed-point residual r_k = d_{k+1} - d_k with m=2 history vectors and strict projection to [d_lower_bound, 1.0]. Avoids the Package 126 divergence by requiring a residual contraction condition before accepting the accelerated step.
controlled_variables: Preserve exact C4 mesh and Increment 86.75 checkpoint
Anderson depth m=2 with safeguard fallback to standard AM if ||r_acc|| > ||r_k||

follow_on_hypotheses.name: Eighth-Step Continuation (Delta u = 2.22 nm)
follow_on_hypotheses.concept: Cut the displacement increment in half again from 4.45 nm to 2.22 nm.
follow_on_hypotheses.assessment: DE-PRIORITIZED: Empirical evidence from H9 (17.8 nm), H16 (8.9 nm), and H18 (4.45 nm) demonstrates that Cycle-25 Delta d is 0.00145, 0.001445, and 0.001486. The contraction floor is invariant to macroscopic step bisection, rendering further pure bisection scientifically unpromising without relaxation or acceleration.
